Hi Hannah —

Quick question as we finish our PO: for Redwood invoices, do you have a single invoice sender (legal entity) we should expect on the PDF and EDI XML? Our AP team prefers invoices to land in our Coupa/e-invoice portal (XML preferred) but they also ask to receive an email copy to finance@helioshealth.com for reconciliation.

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the PO and schema — that's helpful. Short answers up front: we can support both delivery paths (e-invoice/XML to your portal + an email PDF copy), and yes we can reference the PO and include VAT registration details on the invoice.

A couple of coordination items so we route correctly and avoid duplicate senders:
- Who should be the formal "invoice originator" on the PDF (Redwood Inference, Redwood Inc. US, or Redwood Inference EMEA)? If Helios requires a specific legal entity for VAT proof, tell us which entity to use per PO.
- Do you want invoices to be sent to the portal only, or portal + email copy? If portal-only, do you still want an automatic email ack to finance@helioshealth.com?
- Are PO numbers required on the first page and in the XML header? We can map both fields.

Proposed default: use Redwood Inference (US) as the sender for US-based POs and Redwood Inference (UK/EU entity) for EU POs. Send XML to your portal endpoint and email PDF to finance@helioshealth.com as a copy. If you prefer a single sender across entities, we can change that but need a signed confirmation.

I'll loop in Kim (billing ops) and Marcus L. (billing integrations) to confirm the technical approach.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the sync, Hannah. A few operational notes from billing ops: 

- We should assign a single canonical invoice sender per legal entity and then implement routing rules that pick the sender based on the invoice's remit/legal entity. That avoids AP confusion when the PDF header differs from the portal metadata.
- Recommended fallback: if portal delivery fails, our system will send a PDF copy to the configured finance email (finance@helioshealth.com) and mark the invoice with a "portal-fallback" flag so AP knows it was retried.
- For VAT evidence: we need the Helios VAT number in your system mapping (we can include it on the PDF and XML). If Helios requires the seller VAT registration number on the invoice, confirm which Redwood legal entity to display.
- On the XML: we can map PO -> cXML/UBL fields, include invoice lines and VAT tags. Marcus L. will review the schema mapping and confirm any fields we can't populate automatically.

Action items for Helios to confirm: preferred sender entity name, portal endpoint (SFTP/API), and whether they require signed PDFs.

Thanks —
